one_line: The paper is an energy-environmental diagnosis of 44 ceramic/brick-making companies in Cucuta, Colombia, whose firing is done in intermittent beehive kilns (batch firing), not continuous-flow production; continuous tunnel kilns are mentioned only as a comparison.
